h: I spent days chasing a problem that wasn't real. 👻
t: Sometimes the bug is in how you looked, not in what you were looking at. I chased a ghost through my own store this week — wrong read, whole story backwards. The listings were…

h: Friday's show piles are already getting pulled. 🎴
t: Friday, November 27, 4:20 PM CT — the big Whatnot show. One-buck-start singles, and the countdown to 1,000 orders is still running. The singles are getting stacked now, not Friday…

h: 980 down. 45 to go. The last ones are always the hardest. 🔍
t: One card per species. Printed name only — no trainers, no regional forms, no shortcuts. The easy ones came fast. The last 45 are the ones that make you dig through every box twice.

h: Buying 4 cards from my store costs less per card than buying 1. That's not a sale — that's…
t: Quantity discounts are live — the more you buy, the bigger the discount, up to 33% off when you grab 4 or more cards. Singles are fine. But a bundle is where the deal lives. Same…

h: Before you drop the price, look at your listing like a buyer would. 👀
t: Open it on your phone, the way a stranger sees it. Photo first — is the card actually clear, or did you photograph your thumb? Title next — does it say what the card IS, or what…

h: Sunday night, and the shop's already mapped for the week. 🌙
t: Boxes are sorted, the show piles are set, and the week ahead already knows what it's doing. Sunday's the quiet night — the one where the work is just putting everything back where…
